purpose: Teach: 明後日/ソファー/身の回り/空腹/憶え/定か/あこがれ/わが家

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと明後日のお花見を計画したぞ
lines.en: Grandmother, when I was young, Father and I planned a hanami viewing for the day after tomorrow.
lines.style: Soft, memory-distant opening. Pause on 'Grandmother' — a lifelong habit of address. Slow, reverent pace. Voice settles into the recollection like settling into an old chair.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ソファーでお昼寝されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes dear, and Grandfather, you had quite the nap on the sofa that day, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, knowing chuckle underneath. Gentle tease from someone who was there. Bright but unhurried — the rhythm of a long marriage. Soft landing on the endearment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの身の回りをばあさんがお世話されたぞ
lines.en: Grandmother, when I was young, I took care of Father's daily needs — that was something.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the memory. Tender admission masquerading as simple fact. Slower still. The weight of 'something' — small act, large meaning.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、空腹のときお腹を鳴らされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes, and Grandfather, your stomach would rumble when you were hungry — I remember that so clearly.
lines.style: Fond, almost playful. The intimacy of noticing small human things. Voice warm and present, not distant. She's with him in the memory, not just recalling it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが歌を一度で憶えてくださったぞ
lines.en: Grandmother, when I was young, Father could memorize a song after hearing it just once.
lines.style: Admiration in the voice — not boasting, but honoring something lost. Slow, deliberate. Breath after 'once' — the impossible gift of it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、戦争中の記憶は定かじゃないとおっしゃってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather, but you said your memories from the war weren't entirely clear, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Not contradicting — gently correcting the record, as only she would know it. Tender but honest. Voice doesn't waver.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが医者になることにあこがれていたぞ
lines.en: Grandmother, when I was young, Father yearned to become a doctor.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. This was his father's dream — and his own, perhaps. Wistful but grounded. Space between each phrase, like stepping stones through time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、わが家の伝統を守ってくださったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, Grandfather — you kept our family's traditions alive, just as he would have wanted.
lines.style: Voice softens at the close. This is the final turn — acknowledgment and benediction. Slow, deliberate, intimate. Breath visible in the words. Lands gently, like a hand on his cheek.
